# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_82/training_0.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_82/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_82/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_82/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_82/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_82/training_7.csv",
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all DataFrames (UNION operation)
Target6_82 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns have correct dtypes as per target schema
# Target schema: ['created': string, 'screenname': string, 'followers': integer, 'favourites': integer, 'text': string]

# Convert 'created' to string (it may be datetime or string)
Target6_82['created'] = Target6_82['created'].astype(str)

# Convert 'screenname' to string
Target6_82['screenname'] = Target6_82['screenname'].astype(str)

# Convert 'followers' and 'favourites' to integer (if floats present, convert safely)
Target6_82['followers'] = pd.to_numeric(Target6_82['followers'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
Target6_82['favourites'] = pd.to_numeric(Target6_82['favourites'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Convert 'text' to string
Target6_82['text'] = Target6_82['text'].astype(str)

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file without the index
Target6_82.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
